description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for capturing and anonymising a screenshot that is about to ship into documentation — risk tier, OCR detection, deterministic redaction, the pre-embed human gate. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (image analysis, image editing/inpaint, image generation, the provided-design spec path, PII scrubbing on text surfaces) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: capture a screenshot of the admin dashboard for the feature docs
I want to embed a screenshot of this settings page in the README — is it safe to ship?
redact the customer names and the local path in this screenshot before it lands in docs/media/
mach einen Screenshot für das Doku-Kapitel und anonymisiere vorher alles Sensible
can this dashboard screenshot go on the docs site, or does it leak PII?
analyse this character image feature by feature and diff it against the canon
queries.note: per-feature image analysis / canon drift, not doc-shipping anonymisation → image-analyser (this skill only borrows its OCR read)

queries.q: inpaint the background out of this photo and give me a couple of variations
queries.note: image editing / lossy inpaint — explicitly forbidden as a redaction method here → image-editing

queries.q: generate a banner image for the launch post
queries.note: image generation from a brief, not a captured screenshot → image-generation (brand assets → brand-asset-generation)

queries.q: here's a screenshot of the mockup — build the UI to match it 1:1
queries.note: a user-supplied screenshot used as a design spec to build against → design-fidelity (rule) / cross-source-consistency

queries.q: scrub the email addresses and tokens out of these log lines before we ship them
queries.note: PII redaction on a text surface (drafts / logs / exports), not inside an image → domain-safety-pii (rule)
